report.headline: New site launched, booking tracking live, and three new video ads in production

done.text: Launched the redesigned website with all tracking carried over from the old site: call tracking, ad integrations, and form-to-CRM connections.
Both thank-you pages are live. All 5 forms and the appointment calendar now redirect to the correct thank-you page (English or Arabic) after submission, and lead tracking events fire on each.
Completed initial Google Business Profile SEO review and delivered a full report.

Fixed and published the Crown Point booking attribution workflow. Both Meta and Google booking paths tested and confirmed: click IDs, UTMs, keywords, and the correct ad channel tag all save properly without creating duplicate contacts.

Google Ads restructured since Nov 10: trimmed to 5 high-intent keywords per campaign at top-of-page bids, plus added lower-competition terms. Result: impressions up from ~2/day to ~35/day, 42 clicks at 17% CTR, 92% top-of-page rate.

in_progress.text: Three Ken Peterson video ads are being edited ("Your Plan May Be Going Away", "The Supplement Window", "Extras vs. Your Meds") — cut lists are assigned and source footage is ready for the editor.
New Meta video ads for the Ken Peterson campaign are ready to launch pending receipt of the final video files.

Investigating why some leads arriving from Meta and other sources create pipeline opportunities without a source attached — identifying each broken path and fixing them so every new opportunity records where it came from.

Looking into the best way to link related contacts in the CRM (e.g. a caller who is the adult child or spouse of the person needing coverage) — confirming what's already built and defining the method for the team to follow.
Intermittent dropped calls on the Meta line (708-847-5143) are being monitored — tracing each missed call in the CRM by caller number and time to identify the pattern and propose a fix.

waiting_on_you.text: Please send over the office photos you mentioned so we can add them to your Google listings.
Could you confirm whether call forwarding is active on the dedicated Ken Peterson campaign phone number? We need that confirmed before those ads go live.
For the dropped-call issue on the Meta line: when a call drops or doesn't ring, please send us the caller's number and the Chicago time it happened so we can trace it.
Please review the Google Ads budget recommendation (pause Part D, double daily budgets for Medicare Advantage and Supplement to ~$64/day) so we can move before open enrollment ends Dec 7.

next_week.text: Apply Google Business Profile updates: holiday hours (closed Thanksgiving & Black Friday, open Nov 30–Dec 7 including weekends), English + Arabic languages, and fix the all-lowercase location name.
Deliver the three Ken Peterson edited ads for approval, then launch the Meta campaign once the dedicated tracking number is confirmed.
Complete setup and testing of the Ken Peterson dedicated phone number — confirm forwarding order, CRM logging, and source tagging before the ads go live.
Fix all opportunity-source gaps so no new lead enters the pipeline without a recorded source.

Reviewer should confirm published status in GHL.

Reviewer should check whether videos were shared after the window closed.
Build Thank You Pages (13397447806): item is not marked Done in the window (marked_done_in_window: false) but the specialist's 11/18 post says both pages are live. Recommend marking Done in Monday.
